question: Which five Souls-like games with at least 10,000 user reviews have the best review ratio?
key_points: Top by Wilson lower bound (>=10k reviews): Papa's Freezeria Deluxe (99.3%, 11k), Dead Cells (97.1%), Hollow Knight (97.0%), Pseudoregalia (97.1%, 15k), Black Myth: Wukong (96.7%)
Gives vote counts or notes ranking accounts for review count

args.sql: select name, positive+negative n_votes, positive_ratio, positive_ratio_lower95 from games_all where list_contains(tags,'Souls-like') and positive+negative >= 10000 order by positive_ratio_lower95 desc limit 5

question: How many games in the Steam catalog priced at $0 were released in 2023?
key_points: 3,526 games priced at $0 released in 2023 in the catalog snapshot

args.sql: select count(*) n from games_all where price_usd = 0 and year(release_date) = 2023

question: What is the median price of Roguelike Deckbuilder games released in 2024?
key_points: Median price $4.99 across 138 Roguelike Deckbuilder games released in 2024

args.sql: select median(price_usd) median_usd, count(*) n from games_all where list_contains(tags,'Roguelike Deckbuilder') and year(release_date)=2024

question: Which game in the 300-game review corpus has the highest peak concurrent player count?
key_points: Call of Duty has the highest peak_ccu in the snapshot (67,419), ahead of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT (66,954) and Baldur's Gate 3 (54,771)
Ideally notes peak_ccu is the snapshot's recorded peak, not all-time peak

args.sql: select name, peak_ccu from games order by peak_ccu desc nulls last limit 3

question: Which three games in the review corpus have the lowest overall positive review ratio?
key_points: Kerbal Space Program 2 (29.6%, ~29k votes), Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown (36.2%), Empire of Sin (47.2%)

args.sql: select name, positive_ratio, positive+negative n_votes from game_summary where positive_ratio is not null order by positive_ratio limit 3

question: Compare the overall review ratio of Hades and Hades II.
key_points: Hades 98.2% positive (~280k votes) vs Hades II 94.9% (~64k votes); Hades is higher

args.sql: select name, positive_ratio, positive+negative n_votes from games_all where appid in (1145360,1145350)

question: Which City Builder games released since 2022 with at least 5,000 reviews are rated best?
key_points: Ranked by lower bound: Minami Lane (97.8%, 5.3k), Thronefall (96.6%), Dorfromantik (96.5%), Against the Storm (95.0%), Dwarf Fortress (94.9%)
Restricts to City Builder tag, release >= 2022, >= 5,000 reviews

args.sql: select name, release_date, positive+negative n_votes, positive_ratio, positive_ratio_lower95 from games_all where list_contains(tags,'City Builder') and release_date >= '2022-01-01' and positive+negative >= 5000 order by positive_ratio_lower95 desc limit 5

question: How many games tagged both Open World and Survival cost under $20?
key_points: 1,572 games tagged both Open World and Survival under $20

args.sql: select count(*) n from games_all where list_contains(tags,'Open World') and list_contains(tags,'Survival') and price_usd < 20

question: Do players spend more time on average in Baldur's Gate 3 or in ELDEN RING?
key_points: ELDEN RING: average playtime 8,155 min (~136 h), median 5,832 min; Baldur's Gate 3: average 7,562 min (~126 h), median 4,698 min
ELDEN RING is higher on both average and median

args.sql: select name, average_playtime_forever, median_playtime_forever from games_all where appid in (1086940,1245620)

question: Between 2018 and 2024, which year saw the most game releases in the Steam catalog?
key_points: 2024 has the most releases (20,033), then 2023 (14,598) and 2022 (12,288)

args.sql: select year(release_date) y, count(*) n from games_all where year(release_date) between 2018 and 2024 group by y order by n desc

question: Is the positive share of HELLDIVERS 2 reviews going up or down over the last 6 months of data?
key_points: Last 6 months = Jun-Nov 2024; trend is flat (not significant, p~0.87) at ~70% positive overall
Dip in Aug 2024 (~49% positive) then recovery to ~87% in Oct and ~82% in Nov; change point Sep 2024 (65% -> 80%)

question: How did Cities: Skylines II's monthly review volume evolve over its first year?
key_points: Volume peaked at launch (21.7k reviews Oct 2023, 10.1k Nov) and fell to ~1-2k/month by early 2024 and under 1k/month by Aug-Oct 2024
Positive share also fell from ~53-62% to a low of ~26% in Mar 2024 before partially recovering (~43-57%)

question: Has Palworld's review volume fallen since launch, and when did it shift most?
key_points: Yes: 11.7k reviews in Jan 2024 (launch), 3.5k in Feb, then a few hundred per month (157 in Nov 2024)
Positive share stays high (~94% overall); most likely shift around Apr 2024 (94% -> 91%)

question: Are Lost Ark's reviews getting more positive or more negative over the last 12 months of data?
key_points: Last 12 months (Dec 2023-Nov 2024): more negative. Positive share fell by roughly 10 points across the window (significant downward trend, p~0.017; the tool reports it as about -11 points/year, either phrasing is fine); ~51% positive overall
Change point Apr 2024: ~55% -> ~48% positive

question: Did HELLDIVERS 2's positive share change around 3 May 2024, when the PSN account requirement was announced?
key_points: Before (Feb-Apr 2024) 66.0% positive vs after (Jun-Aug 2024) 64.7%: a 1.3-point drop, statistically significant (p<0.001) but small
Event month (May 2024) is excluded from both windows

question: Looking quarter by quarter, is Valheim's review volume rising or declining since 2021?
key_points: Quarterly volume declined: ~42.6k reviews in Q1 2021 (launch period) to ~5-9k per quarter in 2024
Positive share flat-ish (~85%); ideally notes a shift down around early 2022 (88% -> 82%)

question: Has EA SPORTS FC 25's positive share improved month over month since it launched?
key_points: Data covers Sep-Nov 2024 only (3 months): 35.0%, 30.2%, 38.8% positive; no significant trend (p~0.68)
Overall ~35% positive; says the window is too short for a firm trend

question: When did Cyberpunk 2077's positive review share change the most?
key_points: Biggest shift around Apr 2022: positive share ~68% before vs ~89% after
Overall trend up (~+7 points/year, significant)

question: What do players complain about most in Cities: Skylines II reviews?
key_points: Performance is the most mentioned aspect (44% of reviews, about half of those negative; complaint share ~23%)
Bugs: 30% mention, 77% of mentions negative (complaint share ~23%); price complaints ~12%
Overall positive share ~50%

question: Which aspects dominate the complaints in EA SPORTS FC 24 reviews?
key_points: Overall only ~35% positive
Bugs (complaint share ~18%) and price (~14%) are the top complaint aspects, then performance (~8%) and gameplay (~6%)

question: How often do Baldur's Gate 3 reviews mention bugs, and how negative are those mentions?

Overall ~98% positive

question: What do reviewers say about Hogwarts Legacy's performance on PC?

Overall ~89% positive; may quote example reviews

question: Is price a common complaint in Call of Duty reviews?

Bugs are the biggest complaint (~23%); overall only ~23% positive

question: What share of Lethal Company reviews talk about gameplay, and how positive are they?

question: What were the main complaints in New World reviews during 2024?

question: In Tale of Immortal's English reviews, is the story discussed more or less favourably than the gameplay?

question: Did Cities: Skylines II reviews improve after the Modding Wavelet patch 1.1.0f1?

question: Did Palworld's Sakurajima update change how players review the game?

question: Did Tale of Immortal's reception change after its official 1.0 release?

question: Did bug complaints about Cyberpunk 2077 fall after Patch 1.2?

question: How did players react to Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1?

Bug and price complaints fell significantly (bugs ~23% -> ~5%, price ~35% -> ~16%)

question: Did Warhammer 40,000: Darktide's positive share change after Patch #17?

question: Did performance complaints about Satisfactory change after Update 4?

Overall positive share stays ~97%
